motion.name: control-transition
motion.purpose: Native button states; disabled for reduced motion.

motion.name: step-hop
motion.value: sin(pi * step progress) * height; 6/3.5/2.8/2/1.5 world pixels for Scout/Hauler/Warden/Scoop/Bristleback; Duck 1.8 on land/.35 in water, Frog 8, Snail .25, other water actors .7
motion.purpose: Step profiles follow actual simulation progress; Dozer and Bulk hauler share Scoop's 2px lift. Duck waddles/paddles, Frog hops and Snail glides. Shadows and sorting origins stay on the ground; reduced motion removes lift/rock/squash. New profiles have source/test evidence without a valid current native motion capture.

motion.name: terrain-work
motion.value: sin(pi * elapsed / .4s) * 5px Scoop/2px other-body dip; three-particle warm dust puff over .4s
motion.purpose: Successful terrain/obstacle work and recharge share the strain beat; Dozer leans into a push. Footprint and shadow stay planted. Pause freezes elapsed time; reduced motion removes dip and puff. New reactions have source/test evidence without a valid current native capture.

motion.name: creature-personality
motion.value: 8s idle cycle; Duck left/right head looks for .75s each; predator sniff dip 1.8px over 1s; Snail tucked head near threats
motion.purpose: Reusable head poses share the existing atlas, camera and support origin. Idle gestures use the frozen presentation clock and stop for reduced motion or depleted power; Snail's static threat pose remains. New poses have source/test evidence without a valid current native capture.

motion.name: enemy-notice
motion.value: .45s distant detection notice; 9px exclamation pop; .75s ground-ring fade; body scale X -.04/Y +.07 at reaction peak
motion.purpose: One yellow notice cue precedes distant pursuit; already-adjacent opponents trade their first automatic volley immediately. Reduced motion retains a static exclamation/ring. Forked Watch's authored Bristleback/Crab circuits wait for blockers and resume after pursuit; ordinary creatures retain seeded wandering. New cue/patrol states have source/test evidence without a valid current native capture.

motion.name: goal-star
motion.value: 76px cubic ease-out rise (1-(1-t)^3) over 1.25s; 0.35s without travel for reduced motion
motion.purpose: Reward arrival with the existing chime before completion choices; canvas click, game-surface Space, or Escape can skip while focused buttons retain Space activation.

motion.name: flag-cloth
motion.value: 2.8s native loop; 3 radians/second scene cloth; fixed mast
motion.purpose: A breeze moves only the cloth; bonus stars reflect saved authored delivery or original-unit arrival awards.

motion.name: mission-question
motion.value: 4px bob over 3.6s with a separate shadow
motion.purpose: Mark an available unexplored mission while names and hit areas remain stable; future missions have stationary dark locks.

motion.name: earned-residents
motion.value: seven missions earn two residents each; Ancient Valley earns one Mender; Harbor Run earns Tugboat/Freighter
motion.purpose: Authored land/water patrols earned on matching mission completion, without replay duplicates; decorative travel stops for reduced motion.

motion.name: presentation-clock
motion.value: Mission idle loops freeze on pause, while hidden and for reduced motion; work/notice beats and smoke puffs freeze on pause; world clock freezes while hidden/asleep.
motion.purpose: Preserve the current physical pose and gameplay state. Reduced motion keeps static threat cues while suppressing idle looks/sniffs, step lift/rocking, work reactions and notice travel/stretch.

motion.name: construction-smoke
motion.value: .7s billow; .25s static puff for reduced motion
motion.purpose: Immediate construction, dismantling and destruction share a puff that reveals underlying parts; its elapsed time freezes on pause. Native construction is visually captured; combat and preference variants have source evidence.

motion.name: whirlpool-spiral
motion.value: 2.5-turn projected spiral; 1.4 radians/second; 3–28 world-pixel radius with 1:2 vertical projection
motion.purpose: Linked shallow-water entries on the lower water plane. The shared presentation clock freezes on pause and for reduced motion; hover outlines the linked exit in yellow.

breakpoints.name: narrow-camera-fallback
breakpoints.purpose: Source-only initial-camera fallback below this width; desktop full-board fit remains at or above it. This is not a mobile reflow rule.

components.name: Reset Progress Hold Control
components.description: Continuous three-second primary pointer, Space or Enter hold confirms; interrupted holds cancel. The snippet depicts its native idle state.

components.name: Builder’s License
components.description: Cream printable keepsake using the license corner radius (16px), shared rank portrait, saved bonus count and earned world stamps. Source-derived record only; no preview or current visual verification.

components.name: Construction Preview and Feedback
components.description: Source-derived pattern only: the selected shared model uses its planted origin/depth at alpha .55 within the 3×3 supply area (96px units/76px relay). Feedback uses a lime ready check, pictured missing counts or coral site cross; site problems outrank ingredient deficits, and a legal empty battery adds its gray empty-cell picture. Titles/accessible labels carry details. The snippet extracts only the ready/site symbols with the final 20px source sizing; no browser recapture, model ghost or ingredient preview is implied.

components.name: Pictured mission objectives
components.description: The current goal uses its flag/star and 34px shared creature portraits; or separates alternatives and original identifies the authored rescue target. Shared resources show cargo, a carried tree or minimum remaining charge; the shield means clear enemies. Complete labels live in title/ARIA text. The bonus is hidden until the main, then replaces it. Action and hover feedback flow beneath with 12px gaps. Native 650×562 choice, rescue, convoy and bonus states are recorded in .impeccable/review/objective-clarity/evidence.md; no standalone component preview is synthesized.

narrative.overview:
The implemented visual world uses original fitted toy machines, saturated molded-plastic colors, broad highlights, readable eyes, rounded leaf trees, and chunky stones. Bright cyan water and sunny sand sit beside spring-green grass on thick raised earthy faces, framed by deep navy and cool blue controls. Each machine has a clear role: a narrow lime Scout, a broad orange Hauler with an empty bed, a thick cobalt Warden, a compact yellow Scoop with turquoise arms and hubs, and a red six-legged Bristleback.

The [approved study](.impeccable/mocks/toy-world-study.png) and [approval record](.impeccable/mocks/toy-world-study.json) remain historical silhouette/material references. The [September 30 feedback contract](.impeccable/user-feedback-brief.md) supersedes illustrated rovers/rocks, textured terrain, the sidebar/mobile layout, Scoop cargo, and premature freighter scenery. Playable one-tile boats now belong to authored Open Sea missions; boat residents are earned only by completed boat-bearing levels there. Quiet broad terrain planes are a reversible trial, not a final user-approved style. The [campaign-rules contract](.impeccable/campaign-rules-brief.md) and [campaign expansion contract](.impeccable/campaign-expansion-brief.md) extend finite stock, ordered access, pictured goals and three landscapes while preserving this world. Authored mission geometry and sparse desktop controls govern composition; the study is an identity reference rather than a map composition comp. Attributed reference research and the historical gameplay discussion below remain intact.
keyCharacteristics: Original glossy toy bodies with distinct role silhouettes and four direction views.
Quiet terrain planes on raised coast geometry against a deep blue field.
Shared pictures for board objects, blueprints, resources, and cargo.
Sparse native controls with white text, yellow active states, and lime charge cues.
Presentation motion that follows actual movement and freezes with pause or reduced motion.

rules.name: The Yellow State Rule
rules.body: Use yellow to identify the current command, selection, mission markers or primary completion action; use green for charge and completed-goal status.

rules.name: The Short Label Rule
rules.body: Keep the normal view to names, short goals, action labels, pictures, and counts. Put unit details and instructions behind their native disclosure controls; show one short objective with pictured shipment requirements, and keep mission-specific hints inside How to play.

rules.name: The Ground Contact Rule
rules.body: Align cutouts to their physical footprint centers in `src/view/grounding.ts`, rather than the lowest alpha edge. Soft contact shadows share a ground layer beneath all upright objects. World objects sort by footprint position; cargo sorts inside its carrier. Idle bodies, facing changes, and flag masts preserve contact with the tile. A moving body may lift briefly during a step, while its footprint, sorting origin, and shadow stay on the terrain. Tile markings stay below bodies; charge bars and status remain above them.

dos: **Do** reuse the same toy pictures across the board, blueprints, recipes, resources, and cargo.
**Do** use calibrated footprint centers, raised land faces, and the shared ground-shadow layer.
**Do** keep authored levels and camera controls authoritative over the study's illustrative arrangement.
**Do** keep command, charge, selection, and hazard states readable above bright terrain.
**Do** freeze presentation motion on pause or reduced motion while preserving independent orders and existing rules.
donts: **Don't** restore the superseded mint/teal/warm-paper placeholder palette on current game surfaces.
**Don't** use LEGO marks, studs, figures, or copied models for this original world.
**Don't** bake inventory, a floor, or cast shadows into the reusable character pictures.
**Don't** treat the approved art study as a pixel layout contract or the focused evidence as whole-game validation.
